title: IT Specialist and IT Developer
description:
IT SPECIALIST



The IT Specialist is a strategic position that plays a pivotal role in the data integrity of key My Amazon Guy functions. The position is responsible for assisting the CTO and IT Department, maintaining and enhancing dashboards, data models, and data pipelines. Possess advanced analytical and decision-making skills. The role requires someone who is passionate about data quality, data analytics, and automation in order to drive business strategy.



An ability to be an expert in problem-solving, critical thinking, and an understanding of complex system dependencies are essential in enabling the IT Manager to show where My Amazon Guy processes are broken and how those processes are affecting key data points. An individual with a strong passion to solve problems and improve data integrity will excel in this position.



Key Responsibilities:

• Manage and maintain company IT systems, ensuring optimal performance, reliability, and security across all platforms.

• Provide technical support and troubleshooting for software, and network-related issues across teams.

• Ensure implementation and compliance with security systems, including antivirus, firewalls, and two-factor authentication.

• Oversee and optimize the use of company tools (e.g., Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Asana, Slack, Monday, HubSpot, WordPress).

• Support website management and CMS platforms, ensuring functionality, updates, and performance optimization.

• Analyze system data and create reports, dashboards, and visualizations to support decision-making.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to understand workflows and improve system integrations and data architecture.

• Assist in automation and process improvements, including API integrations and workflow optimization where applicable.

• Document IT processes, provide training, and ensure teams are equipped to use systems efficiently.

• Proactively identify technical issues, recommend solutions, and implement improvements to enhance operational efficiency and quality output.



Qualifications:

• 1+ years of experience in an IT Help Desk role

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Ability to multitask and prioritize

• Experience with

• Data Analytics

• Jotform

• Airtable

• Zapier

• Hubspot

• Asana

• Google Workspace

• Database management is a plus but not required

• JavaScript, Python, CSS, HTML is a plus but not required

• Proficient with Microsoft Office, G Suite applications, and computer security systems

• Proficient with, or able to quickly become proficient with, a range of general and specialized applications, software, and hardware used in the organization and the industry.

• Expert in problem-solving, critical thinking, and an understanding of complex system dependencies



----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



IT DEVELOPER



The IT Developer is responsible for managing the end-to-end development of systems, applications, and web platforms. This role thrives in a remote, collaborative environment and provides support to cross-functional teams by delivering both front-end and back-end solutions, system integrations, automation, and technical troubleshooting.



The IT Developer is highly organized, detail-oriented, and technology-driven, with the ability to communicate effectively across teams, manage complex workflows, and quickly adapt to new tools, technologies, and processes.



Key Responsibilities:

• Design, develop, and maintain full-stack web applications, internal tools, CMS platforms, APIs, databases, and cross-platform integrations.

• Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across company systems, applications, workflows, and web platforms.

• Implement automation and integration solutions using tools such as Zapier, while maintaining company software and applications.

• Analyze data and create dashboards, reports, charts, and visualizations using Excel, Google Sheets, and other reporting tools.

• Ensure system security and compliance through appropriate security standards and practices.

• Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders to deliver integrated solutions, improve processes, and optimize systems.

• Provide technical guidance, training, support, mentorship, and knowledge sharing across the team.

• Document systems, architecture, processes, workflows, and technical knowledge to improve accessibility and continuity.

• Support ad-hoc technical tasks and organizational priorities as needed.



Qualifications:

• Proficiency in ReactJS, TypeScript, SQL, and Python.

• Experience with GitHub and version control workflows.

• Basic understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and development best practices.

• Familiarity with front-end and back-end development and database management.

• Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Good attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment and adapt to new tools and technologies.



What We Offer:

• Competitive salary base

• Permanent remote setup

• Unlimited free access to MAG School courses and SOP Library

• Opportunities for professional development and career advancement

title: DSP Manager
description:
The DSP Manager is responsible for managing and optimizing the demand-side platform to enhance digital advertising performance. This role involves strategic planning, campaign management, and collaboration with internal teams and external partners to drive effective advertising solutions.



Key Responsibilities:

• Create SOPs and effectively lead a team to ensure smooth operations and achieve organizational goals

• Proficient in data analysis and reporting tools, with the ability to interpret complex data sets

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

• Familiarity with major DSPs (e.g., Google Marketing Platform, The Trade Desk) and digital marketing platforms

• Competitive salary base

• Permanent WFH setup

• Unlimited FREE access to MAG School courses and SOP Library!

• Work schedule is in EST (Monday-Friday only)

• Opportunities for professional development and career advancement

title: DTC Website Performance & CRO Manager
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and results-driven Website Performance & CRO Manager to own conversion performance across our Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) client portfolio.



In this role, you will be responsible for improving website conversion rates, optimizing user experience, maintaining website performance standards, and driving measurable revenue growth for Shopify-based brands. You will proactively identify opportunities, develop optimization strategies, execute experiments, and translate data into actionable business decisions.



This is not a task-execution role. We are looking for someone who can independently identify what needs to be optimized, prioritize initiatives based on business impact, and connect every website improvement to measurable performance outcomes.



Key Responsibilities:

• Conduct CRO audits and implement data-driven strategies to improve website conversions and revenue.

• Develop and manage A/B tests across key website pages, using customer behavior and analytics to guide improvements.

• Provide actionable optimization recommendations, wireframes, and implementation guidance.

• Monitor and improve website speed, Core Web Vitals, and overall performance across client accounts.

• Oversee website QA, identify technical issues within one business day, and promptly escalate blockers.

• Manage GA4 tracking and analyze Shopify and website data to identify performance opportunities.

• Establish performance baselines within 30 days and provide monthly reports on CVR, AOV, and revenue impact.

• Manage multiple DTC client accounts, maintain 30/60/90-day optimization roadmaps, and collaborate with DTC Brand Managers.

• Create SOPs and improve CRO, analytics, QA, and website performance processes.



Qualifications:

• 3+ years of experience in CRO, website performance, UX optimization, or DTC e-commerce

• Strong hands-on experience with Shopify, including product pages, themes, site structure, and conversion optimization

• Advanced proficiency in Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

• Experience using Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or similar behavioral analytics platforms

• Demonstrated success running A/B tests and translating results into measurable business outcomes

• Strong understanding of conversion funnels, user behavior, and customer journey optimization

• Experience managing multiple client accounts or projects simultaneously

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

• Agency experience or experience supporting multiple brands is highly preferred



What We Offer:

• Competitive salary base

• Permanent remote setup

• Unlimited free access to MAG School courses and SOP Library

• Opportunities for professional development and career advancement

description:
Have you personally submitted an Android game to Google Play and seen it through approval? We’re hiring someone with that experience. We’ll only review applications that include examples of past submissions and proof of your role in the work.



Our developers build the games and give you a signed Android App Bundle and store assets. You handle the submission in our company’s Play Console and stay with it through review.

 whether to offer more releases.

• Check the bundle, screenshots and store copy. Tell us what’s missing before you submit.

• Give examples of Android games you’ve submitted. For each one, tell us which parts you handled and what happened in review. Include a store link if the game is public.

You’ll oversee guest communication, support and supervise our virtual assistant, and keep bookings, cleaning and maintenance running smoothly. You’ll also improve our procedures and keep the Directors informed when an issue needs their attention.

You’ll report directly to the Directors and work closely with a friendly, growing Perth-based business. We’re looking for someone who wants to stay long term and grow with Elegant Hideaways.

• Track team performance, including response times, issue resolution, guest satisfaction and booking success rates.

• Address performance concerns and keep the Directors informed of significant issues.

• Make sure urgent or high-risk matters are escalated promptly and handled according to our procedures.



Guest communication and property operations

• Manage guest enquiries and communication across Airbnb, Booking.com, VRBO and our direct booking channels.

• Help guests before, during and after their stays with warm, professional communication.

• Handle reservation changes, cancellations and Airbnb resolution requests.

• Resolve guest issues and coordinate with cleaners and maintenance providers.

• Write thoughtful guest reviews and professional responses to public reviews.

Procedures and improvements

• Keep our standard operating procedures accurate, practical and up to date.

• Make sure the team understands and follows agreed processes.

• Identify recurring problems and improve the way we handle them.

What you’ll need

• At least five years’ experience as a virtual assistant.

• Experience coordinating cleaning teams and using platforms such as Turno.

• Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with guests, colleagues and service providers.

• Experience writing, updating and implementing standard operating procedures.

• Strong judgement, attention to detail and the ability to prioritise when several issues arise at once.

• A reliable approach to following up tasks and taking responsibility for outcomes.

We’re particularly interested in people who can explain how they have led a team, resolved difficult guest situations or improved the way an accommodation business operates.





Working hours

This is a fully remote role of approximately 42 hours per week, with regular overlap with Perth business hours.

Occasional additional hours or support outside your usual schedule may be needed for urgent issues. These situations are expected to be rare.

What we offer

• A long-term role with a growing short-term accommodation business.

• The flexibility to work remotely.

• Direct access to the Directors and the opportunity to contribute ideas.

• A friendly, supportive team.

• Opportunities to develop your skills and take on greater responsibility as the business grows.

How to apply

• Your experience in short-term accommodation.

• Your experience with Uplisting and the booking platforms listed above.

title: TikTok Ads Media Buyer (Spark Ads, CPA/App Offers) — $400/mo + 20% Profit Share
description:
About us

Anton Petrov Consulting LLC runs an in-house performance marketing team based in Cyprus. We run TikTok Spark ads on CPA offers — reward apps and mobile games — across European markets, and the team is growing. We fund all ad spend and give you the ad accounts, tools and the winning ads that already work for us. Your job is to test, find what converts, and scale it.



What you'll do

- Run TikTok Spark ad campaigns on one assigned CPA offer (reward or mobile-gaming app) across European markets (Germany/Austria/Switzerland, Nordics, France, UK, Poland, Italy, Netherlands, Belgium)

- Write and test new hooks every day using our testing system (5 hooks per test, one variable at a time)

- Kill losing ad groups fast and step budgets up gradually on winners

- Keep every ad inside TikTok's advertising policies — no income claims, no fake app screens or fake notifications

- Send a short daily report: spend, results, ROAS, hooks tested, what you killed



What we want

- Hands-on TikTok Ads Manager experience — you have run and paid for your own campaigns, not just watched courses

- Prior CPA / affiliate media buying experience is strongly preferred — if you have run CPA, affiliate or app-install offers, tell us which verticals and what results

- Meta Ads experience is a plus

- Strong written English — you'll write hooks and ad briefs for European audiences

- Comfortable with numbers: ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPM

- Reliable internet (25 Mbps+), backup power or backup connection, and your own laptop



Pay — how it works

- USD 400 per month base, paid every month in full.

- Plus 20% of the net profit from your campaigns, paid monthly. Net profit = revenue your campaigns generate minus the ad spend on your campaigns. We pay all the ad spend — you never risk your own money.

- Losses carry forward: if your campaigns end a month at a loss, that loss is subtracted from the next month's profit before the 20% is calculated. The profit share is paid once your running total is back in profit. The USD 400 base is never reduced.

- Example: month 1 your campaigns make $2,000 profit → you get $400 + $400 = $800. If instead month 1 is −$300 and month 2 is +$1,300, month 2's share is 20% of $1,000 = $200 (plus your $400 base each month).

- Paid monthly via Wise, Payoneer or OnlineJobs.ph Easypay.

- 21-day trial on a capped daily ad budget. After the trial we d
 on results (ROAS), not effort. Base pay is paid for the trial period too.

- Strong performers can have the profit share reviewed upward after 3 months.



Hours

- Full time, Monday to Friday, 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM Manila time (our European morning and afternoon)

- Occasional short weekend checks on live campaigns



How to apply (read carefully — applications that skip this are not read)

1. Start your application with the code word SPARKFIRE.

2. Send proof: screenshots of your TikTok Ads Manager and/or Meta Ads Manager (campaign view showing spend and results) and of your affiliate network dashboard (stats/earnings view). You may blur names and IDs, but spend and results must be visible. No screenshots = no interview.

3. Answer these 3 questions:

   - How much have you personally spent in TikTok Ads Manager (total, and in your best month), and what was the ROAS or CPA on your best campaign?

   - Which CPA / affiliate offers or verticals have you run, and on which traffic sources?

   - In 2–3 sentences: what is a Spark ad, and why would you use one instead of a regular in-feed ad?

4. Attach a speed test screenshot from your work setup.



Shortlisted applicants get a short paid test task (5 TikTok hooks + 1 ad brief, USD 25), then a 30-minute video call.

title: Scheduler & Recruiting Specialist
description:
# Now Hiring: Remote Scheduler & Recruitment Specialist

**Full-Time | Long-Term Opportunity | Established U.S. Cleaning Company**



Are you exceptionally organized, a natural problem-solver, and someone who enjoys putting all the pieces of a puzzle together? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two days are exactly alike?



If so, we would love to meet you!



Maid For You is an established, independently owned residential cleaning company based in Concord, New Hampshire, USA. We have been in business for over 20 years and have exciting growth plans ahead of us.



We are looking for a dependable, detail-oriented professional based in the Philippines to join our growing office team in a long-term, full-time remote position combining scheduling and recruiting.



 Position Details



- **Starting pay:** $8.00 USD per hour

- **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–4:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time

- **Location:** Remote – Philippines

- **Employment:** Full-time, long-term

- **Weekends:** Saturday and Sunday off

- **Growth:** Opportunities for professional development, increased responsibilities, and compensation growth based on demonstrated competencies and performance.



 Scheduling Responsibilities



Scheduling will be your primary responsibility. This is much more than simply managing a calendar!



- Coordinate daily and recurring cleaning appointments.

- Manage cleaning technician schedules, availability, and workloads.

- Optimize driving routes and minimize unnecessary travel time.

- Handle employee call-outs, cancellations, and last-minute schedule changes.

- Identify scheduling conflicts and proactively resolve them.

- Maintain accurate customer and scheduling records.

- Coordinate with our sales, customer service, and field teams.

- Ensure efficient scheduling while balancing customer satisfaction, employee satisfaction, and company profitability.

- Anticipate potential scheduling challenges before they become problems.



 Recruiting Responsibilities



During available time between scheduling responsibilities, you will help us build our growing team of exceptional cleaning technicians.



- Manage job postings and incoming applications.

- Review résumés and screen potential candidates.

- Conduct preliminary interviews.

- Coordinate interviews with our leadership team.

- Communicate with applicants throughout the hiring process.

- Maintain accurate applicant records and recruiting pipelines.

- Proactively identify opportunities to attract qualified candidates.

- Support our goal of becoming one of the best places to work in New Hampshire!



## What We're Looking For



Our ideal candidate is someone who:



- Has previous experience in scheduling, dispatching, recruiting, or operations.

- Has excellent written and verbal English communication and comprehension skills.

- Possesses exceptional attention to detail.

- Demonstrates strong critical thinking, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.

- Can confidently manage multiple priorities without becoming overwhelmed.

- Is comfortable working with numbers, schedules, and technology.

- Can work independently and exercise sound judgment.

- Takes ownership of responsibilities and follows through consistently.

- Is proactive rather than reactive.

- Welcomes constructive feedback and enjoys learning.

- Is looking for a stable, long-term career rather than a temporary assignment.



Previous experience working with a U.S.-based residential cleaning company or another field-service business is highly preferred.



## Technology & Remote Work Requirements



- Reliable computer and high-speed internet connection.

- Backup plan for internet and power interruptions.

- Quiet, professional work environment.

- Comfortable participating in frequent video meetings with your camera on.

- Ability to learn and navigate multiple software platforms.



Experience with scheduling software, CRM systems, Slack, ClickUp, Google Workspace, or MaidCentral is a plus.



 Why Join Maid For You?



We believe that exceptional customer experiences begin with exceptional employee experiences.



Our core values are **Honesty, Integrity, Generosity, and Dependability.** We are committed to building a supportive, respectful workplace where our team members feel valued, have opportunities to grow, and take pride in the work they do.



We provide structured training, documented procedures, ongoing support, and opportunities for advancement as our company continues to grow.



We aren't simply looking for someone to fill a position. We're looking for someone who wants to become an integral part of our team for years to come.



 How to Apply



Please submit your updated résumé, an introductory video, and written answers to the following questions:



1. Tell us about your previous scheduling and dispatching experience.

2. Approximately how many employees did you schedule, how many appointments did you manage per day, and how many active customers did the company serve in total?

3. Tell us about your previous recruiting experience.

4. Describe a challenging scheduling situation you encountered and how you resolved it.

5. Are you comfortable working Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–4:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, including changes associated with U.S. daylight saving time?

6. What interests you about this position, and what are you looking for in a long-term employer?



 Required Introductory Video



We would love to get to know the person behind the résumé!



Please submit a short, 2–3 minute introductory video in English with your camera on, addressing the following:



- Introduce yourself and briefly share your professional background.

- Tell us what you enjoy most about scheduling and recruiting.

- Describe how you prioritize your responsibilities when multiple urgent requests come in at the same time.

- Tell us why you believe you would be a great addition to the Maid For You team.



Your video does not need to be professionally produced or edited. We would much rather see your authentic personality and natural communication style than a polished, scripted presentation.



You may submit your video using Loom, Google Drive, or another easily accessible video-sharing platform. Please ensure that your video link has the appropriate viewing permissions.



Application Checklist



- Updated résumé

- Written answers to all six application questions

- Introductory video link



To demonstrate your attention to detail, please include "Scheduling Detailer" in the subject line of your application.



**Only complete applications will be considered.**



Qualified applicants will be invited to participate in an interview and complete a competency assessment as part of our hiring process.



We look forward to meeting our next amazing team member!

title: Procurement & Logistics Assistant
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Position: Procurement & Logistics Assistant

Job Type: Full-Time (Remote)

Work Schedule: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM UK Time



Position Overview



We are seeking a detail-oriented, organized, and proactive Procurement & Logistics Assistant with experience in e-commerce and Amazon FBA operations.



In this role, you will support daily procurement, supplier coordination, inventory monitoring, international shipping, and third-party logistics (3PL) operations.



The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central, strong organizational skills, and the ability to coordinate with suppliers, freight forwarders, and warehouses to ensure timely product deliveries and efficient supply chain operations.



Key Responsibilities



1. Amazon Inventory & FBA Operations

- Assist in creating and monitoring Amazon FBA shipments through Seller Central.

- Track inbound shipments and coordinate deliveries to Amazon Fulfillment Centers.

- Monitor inventory levels, stock availability, and replenishment requirements.

- Ensure products meet Amazon packaging, labeling, and shipping requirements.

- Coordinate stock transfers between 3PL warehouses and Amazon fulfillment centers.



2. Procurement & Supplier Coordination

- Assist in preparing, issuing, and tracking purchase orders (POs).

- Communicate with local and international suppliers regarding production updates, pricing, and delivery schedules.

- Monitor supplier lead times and follow up on outstanding orders.

- Maintain accurate procurement records, supplier information, and order trackers.

- Assist in sourcing products and obtaining supplier quotations.



3. Logistics & Freight Coordination

- Coordinate with freight forwarders, shipping agents, and 3PL providers.

- Track international shipments, particularly from China to the UK, US, and EU.

- Assist in preparing and organizing shipping documents, invoices, and packing lists.

- Monitor shipment delays and communicate updates to the relevant teams.

- Maintain accurate shipping and logistics trackers.



4. Inventory Monitoring & Reporting

- Update inventory spreadsheets and stock movement records.

- Assist in monitoring reorder points and identifying potential stock shortages.

- Reconcile inventory information between Amazon Seller Central and 3PL warehouses.

- Prepare regular procurement, inventory, and shipment status reports.

- Support the team in maintaining accurate supply chain records.



Qualifications & Skill Requirements



Required Experience

- At least 1–2 years of experience in procurement, logistics, supply chain, or e-commerce operations.

- Experience using Amazon Seller Central, particularly FBA inventory and shipment management.

- Familiarity with international shipping, freight forwarding, and 3PL operations.

- Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.

- Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

- Comfortable communicating with international suppliers and logistics partners.

- Willing to use Hubstaff for time tracking.



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience coordinating shipments from China to international markets.

- Familiarity with Amazon FBA prep centers and warehouse operations.

- Knowledge of purchase orders, inventory forecasting, and landed cost calculations.

- Experience using inventory management software or ERP systems.

- Previous experience working with Amazon private-label or e-commerce brands.



 How to Apply



Interested candidates should send a message with the subject:



"Procurement & Logistics Assistant Application"



Please include the following:



- Updated CV or resume link.

- A brief cover letter highlighting your years of relevant procurement and logistics experience.

- Details of your experience with Amazon Seller Central, suppliers, and freight coordination.

- Expected monthly salary in USD.

- Earliest available start date.



Applications with relevant Amazon FBA and logistics experience will be prioritized.

title: AI Architect
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a Principal AI Architect to lead the end-to-end design, integration, and scaling of enterprise artificial intelligence systems. You will bridge the gap between cutting-edge machine learning research, generative AI capabilities, and resilient production infrastructure—ensuring our AI solutions are scalable, secure, cost-effective, and aligned with core business objectives.



Key Responsibilities

Architectural Strategy: Define the enterprise AI blueprint, establishing reference architectures for Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic workflows, and traditional predictive ML pipelines.



System Design & Integration: Architect end-to-end AI platforms across cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), seamlessly connecting data lakes, vector databases, inference engines, and customer-facing applications.



MLOps & Governance: Establish CI/CD/CT (Continuous Training) pipelines, automated evaluation frameworks, observability, and model monitoring to track latency, drift, and hallucination rates.



Security, Ethics & Compliance: Enforce data privacy, model security, and AI governance standards (e.g., SOC2, GDPR, EU AI Act) to mitigate risks related to bias, prompt injection, and data leakage.



Technical Leadership: Mentor ML engineers, data scientists, and software developers; lead build-vs.-buy evaluations for foundation models, orchestration frameworks, and GPU infrastructure.



Stakeholder Alignment: Partner with executive leadership and product teams to translate complex business problems into viable, high-ROI AI roadmaps.

Salary: Competitive, based on skills and experience | TBD



About Us:

Front Row Furniture is a trusted UK-based supplier of quality contract furniture for the events and hospitality industries. Our clients range from event planners and venues to restaurants and hotels, and they rely on us for stylish, durable and affordable furniture backed by excellent service and reliable delivery. We're a small, close-knit remote team, and we're actively bringing AI into how we work across sales, customer service and operations.



The Role:

We're looking for an exceptional Sales and Customer Service Specialist who is tech friendly and genuinely enthusiastic about AI. You'll be the first point of contact for many of our customers, handling enquiries by phone,
, website live chat and online marketplaces, turning leads into orders and making sure every customer gets a quick, clear and helpful answer.



You won't use AI just because you're told to. You're the kind of person who already uses tools like ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini to work faster and smarter, and you're excited to help us build better ways of working.



What You'll Do:

*Sales and lead handling: understand what customers need, recommend the right products, send quotes and follow up until the order is secured.

*Customer service: respond quickly and clearly to enquiries by phone,
 and live chat, and handle questions, concerns and after-sales support with a solutions-first attitude.

*Order and delivery updates: keep customers informed on stock, dispatch and delivery, and work with our logistics side to resolve any issues.

*Platform management: monitor and update product listings and messages on our website and online marketplaces (e.g. eBay, Gumtree, Amazon).

*Systems and records: keep leads, orders and customer records accurate and up to date in our systems (such as Odoo and Google Sheets).

*AI in your daily work: use AI tools to draft replies, research products, summarise information and speed up routine tasks, always checking the output before anything goes to a customer.

*Process improvement: follow our SOPs, suggest improvements, and share ideas on where AI and automation could save time.

*Feedback loop: pass customer insights back to the team to help improve our products, processes and messaging.



What Success Looks Like:

*Enquiries are answered quickly and professionally, and more of them turn into orders.

*Customers always know where their order is.

*Records are accurate, so the rest of the team can rely on them.

*You regularly find smarter, faster ways to do the job, including with AI.

*You become a trusted, go-to person for both customers and colleagues.



What We're Looking For:

*1-3+ years of experience in sales or customer service, ideally with UK, US or international clients.

*Clear, confident spoken and written English. UK or neutral accent strongly preferred.

*Warm, personable and confident on the phone, with a natural sales mindset.

*Tech friendly: you pick up new systems quickly and are comfortable with Google Sheets, CRMs or order management tools.

*AI enthusiast: you use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar) at work or in daily life and can give real examples.

*Good judgement: you know when AI helps and when a situation needs a human touch, and you always check AI output for accuracy.

*Organised, punctual and detail-oriented.

*Proactive and self-managing in a remote setup.

*Reliable WFH setup (fast, stable internet, quality headset, quiet space, backup power if needed).



(Bonus if you've worked with Amazon, eBay, Gumtree or other marketplaces, Odoo or a similar ERP/CRM, B2B sales, order tracking, or the furniture, events or hospitality industries. Not required!)



Why Join Us?

*Make an impact: your work directly shapes customer experience and sales growth.

*Work with AI: join a business that sees AI as a core part of how we work, with room to learn and experiment.

*Supportive team: SOPs, training and ongoing support provided, with leadership that values ideas and initiative.

*Room to grow: responsibility and variety, with opportunities to expand as the business scales.

*Flexibility: remote work during UK business hours.

description:
Read Before Applying, This role is NOT a general virtual assistant or scheduling position.

If you have not prepared patient charts prior to visits (including verifying referrals, authorizations, and benefits), please do not apply.







We are seeking an experienced Virtual Medical Assistant with a strong background in pre-visit chart preparation and insurance verification to support a high-volume multispecialty clinic.







This role is heavily focused on ensuring patient charts are fully prepared, verified, and complete prior to visits, including referrals, authorizations, benefits, and documentation. Candidates must have hands-on experience in chart prep workflows within a U.S. healthcare setting.







Required Experience (Applicants without this will not be considered):



Minimum 1–2 years of hands-on chart preparation experience in a U.S. medical practice

Proven experience preparing charts prior to patient intake (not just data entry or scheduling)





Experience verifying:



Referrals and authorizations

Insurance eligibility and benefits

PCP assignment and coordination of benefits

Experience using payer portals such as Availity, UHC, Tricare, Cigna, etc.

Ability to interpret and communicate patient financial responsibility before visits









Core Responsibility: Pre-Visit Chart Preparation (Primary Focus)



Prepare and audit patient charts 24–48 hours prior to appointments

Ensure completeness of:

Demographics

Active insurance

PCP assignment

Referrals & authorizations (auth #, validity, visits, POS)

Document all verification steps with reference numbers and notes

Coordination & Patient Communication



Notify patients of missing items, financial responsibility, or delays

Coordinate with PCP offices to obtain referrals

Ensure add-on patients are fully prepped before being seen

description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.

Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: Social Media Manager
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a reliable, creative, and highly motivated individual to manage our daily Instagram Reels content operation. Your main responsibility will be to research viral content, recreate and edit high-quality Reels, perform face swaps where required, and independently publish the finished videos across our assigned social media accounts.



We are looking for someone who can work independently, understands social media trends, and knows how to create content that generates views, engagement, and growth.



Key Responsibilities:



- Daily Content Research: Find viral and trending Reels within our niche and identify content with high potential.



- Content Selection: Research successful creators, formats, trends, and viral video concepts.



- Video Editing: Edit and recreate Reels based on selected reference videos.



- Face Swapping: Perform realistic and high-quality face swaps when required.



- Content Optimization: Add captions, subtitles, hooks, transitions, and other necessary edits.



- Daily Publishing: Independently upload and publish the finished Reels to our assigned social media accounts.



- Account Management: Manage the daily posting process and ensure all accounts remain active.



- Performance Tracking: Monitor views, engagement, and overall content performance to continuously improve results.



Daily Requirements:



- Consistent daily research and content production.



- Regular posting across all assigned accounts.



- High-quality editing and attention to detail.



- Meeting agreed daily posting targets and deadlines.



- Staying up to date with viral trends and social media strategies.







 Compensation Structure – Performance-Based Bonus System:



**Important: This position starts with a performance-based compensation model. There is no fixed monthly salary at the beginning. Earnings are based entirely on the performance of the videos you create and publish.** 



Bonus Per Video:



- **50,000+ views:** $10 bonus

- **100,000+ views:** $15 bonus

- **150,000+ views:** $20 bonus



Bonuses are paid per qualifying video. Each video is evaluated individually based on its performance.



-Growth & Scaling Opportunities



This is a long-term opportunity with significant potential for growth.



Initially, you will start by managing a defined number of social media accounts and publishing videos daily. As performance improves and the workflow becomes more efficient, we aim to scale the operation across multiple accounts and significantly increase the number of videos published every day.



Our agency already has established  -SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), proven workflows, detailed instructions, and content strategies - designed to identify, produce, and publish viral-style videos consistently.



You will receive clear guidance and structured processes to help you understand exactly how to research, edit, face-swap, and publish content.



-Future Compensation Opportunities



As the operation grows and results remain consistent, there is an opportunity to expand the compensation structure.



For employees who demonstrate reliability, consistency, and strong performance, the agency may introduce:



- A fixed monthly salary.

- Continued performance-based bonuses on top of the fixed salary.

- Responsibility for managing additional accounts.

- Higher earning potential as the number of accounts and daily video output increases.



Our goal is to build a scalable, long-term partnership where your earning potential grows alongside the agency.**

We are looking for someone who is motivated by performance, takes ownership of their work, and wants to grow with us over the long term.



If you think you're the right fit for this position, please contact us at:

title: Sales and Customer Experience Representative
description:
Customer Experience & Sales Coordinator  

**Residential Window Cleaning | Remote | Sales and Home Services Experience Required**



About the Role



Mauka Cleaning Co. is a residential window cleaning and exterior cleaning company serving homeowners on Oahu.



We are looking for a reliable, organized, phone-savvy **Customer Experience & Sales Coordinator** to manage the customer journey from first contact through booking, follow-up, service coordination, and reactivation.



This is not a passive data-entry position. Your work will directly impact our booked revenue, schedule utilization, customer satisfaction, and company growth.



You must be available to work **8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Friday through Sunday, Hawaii-Aleutian Standard Time.**



Your mission is simple:



**Keep the schedule full, customers informed, technicians supported, and the back office organized.**



---



Key Responsibilities:



1. Inbound Sales and Lead Follow-Up



- Respond quickly to new leads by phone, text, and
.

- Qualify leads and provide basic estimates using company pricing tools and guidelines.

- Move leads through each stage of the sales pipeline.

- Follow up with open estimates and unbooked leads using approved follow-up sequences.

- Reactivate past customers and older leads using approved campaigns and offers.

- Contact flexible customers to fill schedule gaps and pull jobs forward.

- Identify appropriate add-on services and recurring maintenance opportunities.

- Maintain accurate CRM notes and next steps for every lead and customer.

- Ask for the sale confidently and professionally.

-Use Housecall Pro and Slack on the daily



2. Customer Experience and Service Coordination



- Answer customer questions about services, pricing, availability, and scheduling.

- Send booking confirmations, reminders, and service updates.

- Handle reschedules and cancellations professionally.

- Backfill canceled openings using the active sales pipeline.

- Support technicians with access instructions, customer notes, and schedule changes.

- Handle customer complaints calmly and document each issue accurately.

- Coordinate approved touch-ups, go-backs, refunds, and service resolutions.

- Follow up with satisfied customers and request Google reviews.

- Protect the customer experience from booking through completed service.



3. Administrative Operations



- Send internal updates and reminders to the field team.

- Record special instructions, access information, and job notes.

- Track technician bonuses and commissions based on completed jobs and upsells.

- Plan and document yard sign routes for technicians.

- Process approved refunds and document them correctly.

- Set up and track customer payment plans when approved.

- Monitor overdue invoices and conduct polite follow-up calls and messages.

- Keep calendars, customer records, and internal systems accurate and current.



---



*Success Metrics*



Your performance will be measured by:



- Speed to lead

- Estimate-to-sale conversion rate

- Reactivation calls and bookings

- Booked revenue and gross profit

- Schedule utilization

- Customer response time

- Cancellation recovery rate

- Review requests and customer satisfaction

- Accuracy of CRM notes and administrative records



We care about results, not just activity.



---



Requirements



Must-Haves



- At least **2 years of experience** in sales, customer service, office administration, or a related role with a U.S.-based home service company.

- Experience in industries such as window cleaning, pressure washing, landscaping, HVAC, plumbing, cleaning, roofing, or similar.

- Proven experience handling inbound calls, quoting, scheduling, follow-up, customer service, and administrative tasks.

- Strong spoken and written English.

- A natural, confident, and professional phone presence.

- Comfortable making and receiving a high volume of calls and messages. **If the phone ringing makes you want to hide under your desk, this probably is not the role for you.**

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple customers, leads, jobs, and follow-ups without dropping the ball.

- Able to follow scripts, checklists, and documented processes consistently.

- Comfortable asking for the sale and requesting customer reviews.

- Experience using CRM systems. Housecall Pro experience is a plus.

- Comfortable using
, calendars, spreadsheets, and online communication tools.

- Reliable, self-motivated, and able to work independently without constant supervision.

- Able to work from a quiet, professional environment with **no loud background noises, interruptions, or distractions** during working hours.

- Must have a **reliable, high-speed internet connection** capable of supporting phone calls, video meetings, CRM software, and multiple online systems.

- Reliable availability from **8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Friday to Sunday, Hawaii-Aleutian Standard Time**.





Preferred Qualifications



- Experience with residential window cleaning or exterior cleaning.

- Experience with customer reactivation or estimate follow-up.

- Experience coordinating field technicians.

- Experience requesting online reviews.

- Experience handling payment follow-up or basic accounts receivable.



---



Who This Role Isn’t For



This role is **not** a good fit if you:



- Dislike talking on the phone or avoid making outbound calls.

- Need constant supervision to stay productive.

- Struggle to stay organized when managing multiple customers, leads, and tasks.

- Prefer doing things your own way instead of following proven scripts and processes.

- Get discouraged by follow-up, rejection, or customers who need multiple touchpoints before booking.

- Are uncomfortable asking for the sale or requesting customer reviews.

- Frequently miss deadlines, forget follow-ups, or leave CRM notes incomplete.

- Are only looking for a quiet data-entry position. This is a customer-facing, revenue-producing role.

- Have frequent background noise, interruptions, or an unreliable internet connection.

- Cannot reliably work the required schedule.



**If your ideal workday involves avoiding the phone, hiding from follow-up, and hoping the schedule fills itself, this probably is not the role for you.**



---



Compensation



-Base pay starting at $960/month, with growth opportunities.

- Performance bonuses tied to:

  - Revenue sold and collected

  - Completed upsells

  - Service plans sold

  - Reactivated customers

  - Other agreed-upon performance targets



You will receive training on our systems, scripts, pricing guidelines, and processes.



The right person can grow into a *Customer Experience & Sales Manager* by proving they can independently own the customer journey and consistently produce results.



If you are organized, competitive, dependable, and enjoy helping customers while closing business, we want to hear from you.

title: UGC Creator Scout & Manager (Part-Time, Flexible Hours)
description:
DESCRIPTION:

We're a small, very flexible remote marketing team that works over Slack, plus one weekly team call. We're looking for someone to find and manage UGC creators who make short videos for our ads.



SCOUTING

- Find UGC creators with small followings (under 10k) on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts who make natural, talking-to-camera style videos.

- Get each creator's price for one 15-45 second ad video, and shortlist only those who charge $8 or less per video.

- Log everyone in a Google Sheet: handle, platform, follower count, sample video links, country, language, price per video and turnaround time.



MANAGING

- Send our video requests to creators with clear briefs, track deadlines, and chase late deliveries.

- Check each video matches the brief before it reaches us, and ask for fixes when needed.

- Keep creators happy and motivated: quick replies, feedback on their work, shout-outs for good videos, and making sure they're paid on time.

- Send a weekly update on new creators, videos delivered, and who's doing well or falling behind.



THE KIND OF PERSON WE WANT

We don't care when you work. Go to the gym, run errands, live your life. What matters is that you're present and positive. Never leave the team on read. If you can't reply properly right now, just say "at the gym, back in 30 min" and come back when you said you would. Give updates without being chased, flag problems early, try a fix yourself before asking, and be a real team player.



REQUIREMENTS

- Experience finding or managing creators, influencers or freelancers

- A good eye for videos that would work as ads

- Organized, reliable, and good with Google Sheets

- Friendly, clear communicator; other languages are a bonus



TO APPLY

Start your application with the word "UGC". Tell us how you'd find good creators at $8 or less per video and keep them motivated, and paste links to 3 creators under 10k followers you think would fit. Shortlisted applicants will do a small paid test: find 20 creators who fit.

𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗢𝗣𝗣𝗢𝗥𝗧𝗨𝗡𝗜𝗧𝗬



Every successful introduction that leads to a partnership earns you serious money. One good partnership can be worth $5,000-10,000+ as it grows.



𝗖𝗢𝗠𝗣𝗘𝗡𝗦𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡

A qualified appointment means a scheduled call that actually takes place between me and a decision-maker (founder, BD lead, or marketing head) at a crypto launchpad, DEX, chain, or established project, and meets our qualification criteria. Your first qualified appointment each week is covered by your base pay. All appointments and outreach are logged in our tracker; unlogged work doesn't count or pay.



Appointment Bonus: Every additional qualified appointment beyond the first pays $100, split 50% ETH and 50% $GMI (same vesting).



Commission: 20% of ALL upgrade fees generated by each of your partnerships during its first 180 days live. Our 4-level upgrade system means every user your partnership brings in can pay upgrade fees multiple times, and you earn on every single one during your commission window.

Together with our referral program, we give nearly all of our upgrade revenue back to the people who grow the protocol. Every partnership you land gets its own fresh 180-day earning window.

title: Crypto BD Lead: $100 Per Qualified Call + Uncapped Partnership Revenue (Player-Coach)
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

- Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀



Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.



𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆



Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. IMPORTANT: Your subject line must start with BOND OPS .

2. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

3. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

4. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

5. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

6. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.

title: AI Video Editor and Producer (Animation and Sound), Long-Term

 subject: "AI Video Editor Application - [Your Name]"

MSTR,

 coins, token explosions). All visuals must be built from real brand assets and real product screen recordings we provide.

50% of it will be in ETH - which you can sell anytime

50% of it will be in GMI (vested for 18 months)

title: GoHighLevel specialist to build SMS quote follow-up system for Australian roofers
description:
I run an Australian business that follows up quotes for residential roofing companies. When a roofer sends a quote and the customer doesn't respond, we reply to the customer by SMS and
 under the roofer's name, answer their questions and book a roof inspection.



I'm looking for an experienced GoHighLevel specialist to build this as a master template (snapshot) that I can copy for each new roofing client.



The template needs to include:



1. A quote pipeline with these stages: quote sent, following up, replied, hot lead, inspection booked, won, lost, opted out.

2. A Make or Zapier connection from the roofer's job software into GoHighLevel. ServiceM8 and Jobber first, then Simpro and Fergus. A new quote should create a contact and opportunity. An accepted or declined quote should stop all follow-up.

3. A consent check. Messages only go to contacts who ticked the consent box and whose quote is less than 6 months old. Australia has strict spam laws, so this has to work reliably.

4. SMS and
 follow-up from the roofer's own Australian mobile number, which stops as soon as the customer replies.

5. Conversation AI set to suggest mode, so a person approves every reply before it is sent. Questions about price, complaints and insurance should go to the roofer instead.

6. A text to the roofer within 5 minutes when a customer shows interest, with the customer's name, number and quote.

7. An inspection booking calendar with confirmation and reminder texts.

8. Opt-out handling. A STOP reply should set the contact to DND immediately, and every message should include the business name and how to opt out.

9. A Google review request sent to every customer once their job is complete.

10. A dashboard I can use for a monthly report: quotes worked, replies, inspections booked and opt-outs.

11. Written notes and a short Loom explaining how everything works, so someone else could maintain it.



Terms:

Everything is built in my GoHighLevel account. I'll start with a paid test of 3 to 4 hours ($40 to $60). If that goes well, the template is a fixed-price job with a budget of $350 to $600, paid half when it works in testing and half when the first client is live. After that there is ongoing work at $8 to $15 an hour: setting up each new client takes about 10 to 15 hours, and each live account needs about 6 hours a month. Some overlap with Australian business hours (AEST) is needed.



Please answer these questions at the start of your application:

1. What do you need to set up to send SMS from GoHighLevel using an Australian mobile number, and what does the business need to register so its texts don't show as "Unverified"?

2. Send a Loom (under 3 minutes) of a two-way SMS workflow you have built in GoHighLevel where the sequence stops when the contact replies.

3. Have you integrated ServiceM8, Jobber, Simpro or Fergus before? Which one, and with what tool?

4. How would you set up Conversation AI so that no reply is sent without approval?

5. Your hourly rate, your fixed price for this template, and your weekly availability in December.



Applications without a Loom will not be considered.

Coach Wally's Sheet-Pan Salmon & Veggies



Serves 4



One pan, three colors, about 35 minutes. Simple to cook and built for the camera.



Ingredients

• 4 salmon fillets (about 6 oz / 170 g each)

• 4 cups broccoli florets

• 2 medium sweet potatoes, cut into 1/2-inch cubes

• 3 tablespoons olive oil

• 1 large lemon, zested and juiced

• 3 garlic cloves, minced

• 1 teaspoon dried oregano

• 1 teaspoon smoked paprika

• 1 teaspoon salt

• 0.5 teaspoons black pepper



Steps

1. Preheat

    10m

    Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a large sheet pan with parchment paper.

2. Make the lemon-herb mix

    In a bowl, whisk together 3 tablespoons olive oil, 1 large lemon, zested and juiced, 3 garlic cloves, minced, 1 teaspoon dried oregano, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon salt and 0.5 teaspoons black pepper.

3. Roast the sweet potatoes

    15m

    Toss 2 medium sweet potatoes, cut into 1/2-inch cubes with about a third of the lemon-herb mix. Spread on the pan in a single layer and roast.

4. Add broccoli and salmon

    12m

    Toss 4 cups broccoli florets with another third of the mix. Push the sweet potatoes aside, add the broccoli, and place 4 salmon fillets (about 6 oz / 170 g each) skin-side down on the pan. Brush the salmon with the remaining mix. Roast until the salmon reaches 145°F (63°C) and flakes easily.

5. Rest and serve

    3m

    Let everything rest for a few minutes, then serve with extra lemon wedges.



Notes

Pat the salmon dry for better browning. For a plant-based version, swap the salmon for a can of chickpeas tossed with the mix and roasted with the broccoli. Use this as the sample recipe for your paid trial task.

title: Product Research Analyst – Find Trending Products for MercadoLibre Argentina (Amazon → ML)
description:
About the role



We're an established e-commerce company in Argentina selling on MercadoLibre and importing products from China. We're looking for a smart, curious Product Research Analyst who can spot winning products early.



Your mission: look at what's selling and trending on Amazon (US) and figure out which of those products could become a trend/opportunity on MercadoLibre Argentina — and could be imported profitably from China.



This is NOT a copy-paste listing job. We need someone who can think and spot a real business opportunity, not just fill spreadsheets.



What you'll do

- Research trending and best-selling products on Amazon US (categories, movers, new winners).

- Cross-check each idea against MercadoLibre Argentina: Is there demand? How much competition? What are the current prices and margins? Can it be imported from China (Alibaba/1688)?

- Deliver a short, clear weekly list of validated opportunities, with the data and your reasoning (why it's a good bet).

- Flag the real gems — products with demand, beatable competition, and good margin.



What we're looking for

- Analytical, resourceful, and genuinely good at spotting a business opportunity.

- Experience in e-commerce / Amazon product research or online arbitrage is a big plus.

- Comfortable with research tools: Helium 10, Jungle Scout, and/or Keepa. We'll teach you the MercadoLibre side (Nubimetrics + MercadoLibre search) — but you must learn fast.

- English: good enough to communicate and report. Spanish is a strong plus (we sell in Argentina).

- Self-managed and reliable: you work on your own schedule, but you must join one weekly video call to align.



Setup and pay

- Part-time, remote, work independently.

- USD 250/month to start, results-oriented. If you consistently find real winners, there is room to grow the role and the pay.



How to apply (please read — we ignore generic replies)

1. Start your message with the word OPORTUNIDAD so we know you read this ad.

2. Pick ONE product you believe is trending on Amazon US right now that could work on MercadoLibre Argentina. In 4-6 lines, tell us: why it's trending, the likely demand/competition on MercadoLibre, a rough margin idea, and where you would source it from China.

3. Briefly list the research tools you have used and your experience.



We'll reply to the applications that show real thinking. Thanks!

Required Skills

 outreach, networking, and other prospecting channels.

Manage commercial discussions and negotiations to secure mutually beneficial agreements.

title: SEM SMM & SEO Specialist
description:
Full Time Remote Working VA

Job Overview

In this role, you will handle our omnichannel growth effort, running paid ads across Google, Meta, and TikTok, optimizing search rankings, and scaling customer acquisition for our e-commerce store and retail outlets.



Key Responsibilities



Paid Social Advertising : Launch, test, and scale paid ad campaigns across
, Instagram, Linkedin, TikTok. Work closely with the creative team to direct dynamic ad sets, user-generated content (UGC), dynamic product ads, and promotional offers.



PPC & SEM Management: Structure, manage, and optimize Google Ads campaigns (Search, Shopping, Display, Performance Max) to capture high-intent buyers for Ergoworks products.

Analytical mindset with strong data interpretation skills and budget control.

title: Technical Solutions Lead — Measurement, Data And AI (part-time)
description:
US hours, night shift



DeltaSmith is looking for a senior technical problem-solver who designs, builds and checks reliable measurement and data solutions.



You will work across Google Tag Manager, GA4, PostHog, consent tools, data integrations and AI coding assistants, and you will own technical quality for our client work alongside the account manager.



The work: diagnose and simplify technical issues; build fixes or hand them off; check what AI assistants produce; test tracking and data quality; approve releases on evidence; build reusable checklists and monitoring.



What we look for: measurement and tracking experience, JavaScript and integration debugging, consent and privacy in practice, ownership of quality, strong habits with AI assistants, clear writing, and a preference for simple solutions that last.



Arrangement: part-time contractor, starting at 10 hours a week and growing with the work. At least four hours a day inside 09:00–17:00 Bogotá. A small paid trial project comes first, then a two-week paid pilot.



Process: five short questions, then a small paid trial project, then a two-week paid pilot.



Please answer these five questions in your first message:

1. Measurement. GA4 reports about twice as many leads as the CRM. How would you investigate before changing anything?

2. Simplicity. Describe a real solution you simplified, replaced with a setting, or deleted. What was there, what did you change, and why?

3. AI assistants. How do you use AI tools when building or debugging? Give one example where the AI's output was wrong or far too complicated, and how you caught it.

4. Accountability. You are asked to approve a consent change that worked in the developer's tests, but the evidence is incomplete. What do you need before you sign off?

5. Availability and experience. Your weekly hours and your four-hour overlap with 09:00–17:00 Bogotá, and a short summary of your hands-on work with Google Tag Manager, GA4, PostHog, consent tools and JavaScript.

title: Video Editor for Ecommerce Ads (Remote, Full-Time, $4 to $20/hr + Bonuses)
description:
Fully Remote | Long-term Contractor | ~40 hrs/week | $4 to $20 USD/hour + up to $525 bonus per video



About Us

We sell unique, personalized jewelry, gifts and travel products online. Your work is judged on one thing: does the ad sell. Your videos run for real products with real ad spend behind them. Many of our team members have been with us 2+ years.



Pay

title: Senior B2B Cold Calling Superstar – Lead Generation
description:
Are you a natural sales hunter who loves cold calling, getting past gatekeepers and booking appointments? We want YOU!



Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 9am–5pm Perth, Australia Time



QPC Group is an award-winning Australian office technology company, established in 2008.



We're looking for an experienced B2B cold-calling specialist who knows how to turn complete strangers into genuine sales opportunities.



This is a pure outbound lead generation role. Your job is to find opportunities and book qualified appointments — our Australian sales team handles the selling and closing.



What You'll Be Doing



Cold calling Australian businesses using supplied prospect lists and our existing database.



Researching companies, finding decision-makers and confidently getting past gatekeepers.



Building rapport, asking great questions and uncovering business pain points.



Handling objections and turning conversations into qualified sales appointments.



Following up with prospects and keeping accurate CRM records.



Your calling activity will consist of approximately:



60% Cold Calling – Prospecting businesses and generating new opportunities.



30% Warm Database – Reconnecting with existing contacts and identifying opportunities.



10% Supplied Leads – Following up on leads provided by QPC Group.



We provide prospect lists, but you must know how to research businesses, identify the right contacts and reach decision-makers.



Who We're Looking For



You MUST have:



5+ years of proven B2B outbound cold-calling and appointment-setting experience.



Excellent spoken English and a natural, confident telephone manner.



Proven ability to get past gatekeepers, handle objections and reach decision-makers.



Strong prospecting and LinkedIn research skills.



A track record of consistently achieving appointment targets.



We're looking for someone persistent, resilient, self-motivated and genuinely passionate about hunting for new business.



No robotic script readers! We want someone who can have real conversations, build rapport and think on their feet.



Experience in IT, telecommunications, printers, photocopiers or other B2B technology solutions is a bonus.



What Success Looks Like



Our target is a minimum of 30 qualified sales appointments per month.



You must be comfortable with high-volume outbound calling, sometimes making 100+ calls per day.



However, we value quality over quantity. A day with 40 calls and several meaningful conversations can be more productive than 100 unanswered calls.



We measure success by genuine opportunities and qualified appointments, not just how many numbers you dial.



Working Hours



Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 9am–5pm Perth, Western Australia Time



You must have a quiet working environment, reliable internet and backup arrangements for power or internet outages.



How to Apply – Please Read Carefully!



Minimum Apply Points: 3



You must use at least 3 Apply Points when submitting your application through OnlineJobs.ph.



Mandatory Subject Line: Outbound Sales Genius



Please include ALL of the following:



Your CV – Highlight your B2B outbound cold-calling and appointment-setting experience.



Your Sales Results – Tell us your average calls per day, qualified appointments booked per month and targets achieved.



Voice Recording (Mandatory) – Send us a 30-second recording of your best cold-call opening to an Australian business owner about their office printers or photocopiers. We want to hear your confidence, personality and natural conversational skills. Please don't just read a script!



Your DISC Profile (Mandatory) – Include a copy of your DISC personality assessment results.



Working Hours – Confirm you can work Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm Perth, Western Australia time.



Please provide three genuine professional references.



Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph only. Contacting QPC Group outside this platform will disqualify your application.



Ready to Join Us?



If you're a proven sales hunter who loves the challenge of cold calling, getting past gatekeepers and turning a "not interested" into a qualified appointment, we'd love to hear from you!



We're looking for someone who doesn't just make calls — they make things happen!
